LESSON: WRITING 3.4.1 HANDWRITING BRAILLE WRITING

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.4: Writing 3.4.1 Handwriting Braille writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 3.4.1 Handwriting Braille writing, part of Strand 3 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade three ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to write neatly and legibly?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. recognise aspects of good handwriting for effective communication for low vision,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Writing 3.4.1 Handwriting Braille writing in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. recognise aspects of good braille writing for effective communication for low vision,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Writing 3.4.1 Handwriting Braille writing in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. write words in clear and legible handwriting or braille writing,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Writing 3.4.1 Handwriting Braille writing in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. value the importance of writing clearly and legibly for effective communication. • Learners with low vision are guided to look at a sample text of good handwriting. Learners with blindness are guided to tactually explore samples of text with neat and clear braille writing. • Learners are guided to identify aspects of good handwriting in a text while learners with blindness identify neat braille writing in a text. • Learners are guided to copy letter patterns of the target letter-sound combinations (‘cr’ and ‘pl’; ‘st’ and ‘sn) with peers. SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 3.4.1 Handwriting Braille writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: The learner’s ability to write clearly and correctly is enhanced as they write words in clear and legible

handwriting or braille writing.

• Learning to learn: The learner’s ability to learn independently is enhanced as they practise writing neatly and legibly on their own.

Values:
Respect is enhanced as the learner appreciates the effort of peers to write clearly and legibly and assists those with writing difficulties.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Learner Support Programmes (Peer Education and Mentorship): The learner’s ability to mentor others is enhanced as they demonstrate aspects of

good handwriting to peers and assist them to write correctly.

26

Links to other Learning Areas:
The learner is able to apply the handwriting skill or braille writing skills in learning of similar concept in Kiswahili Language Activities.

Suggested Learning Resources

● Print textbooks in appropriate font size and colour contrast

● Braille books

● Digital devices with assistive technology,

● Charts, flash cards or braille cards,

● Pictures or picture description
